title: Retry, Correction and Cancellation Allowances: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Quick Reference
content:
Quick reference for the Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay support desk: how many customer-requested retries and destination corrections each product allows on a failed order, the number of calendar days after failure after which a failed order that has not been retried is refunded automatically, and whether the customer may cancel before the order is sent to the biller.

| Product | Customer-requested retries of a failed order | Destination of a failed order may be corrected | Most destination corrections per order | Calendar days after failure before automatic refund | Customer may cancel before the order is sent to the biller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | 1 | yes | 1 | 3 | no |
| Paloma Data Bundle | 1 | yes | 1 | 3 | no |
| Paloma Electricity Token | 1 | yes | 1 | 3 | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | 1 | yes | 1 | 7 | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | 1 | yes | 1 | 7 | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | 1 | yes | 1 | 7 | yes |

## At a glance

- Every product allows one customer-requested retry and one destination correction per order.
- The automatic-refund period is 3 calendar days for the three products delivered by an operator (Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle, Paloma Electricity Token) and 7 calendar days for the three bill products.
- Only the three bill products (Paloma Bill Pay Utilities, Paloma Bill Pay Television, Paloma Bill Pay School Fees) may be cancelled by the customer before submission to the biller.

## Desk questions on the figures

**How many times can a failed Paloma Electricity Token order be re-sent at the customer's request?** Once: the product allows 1 customer-requested retry.

**Can a Paloma Data Bundle order be cancelled before it is sent?** No; cancellation before submission is not allowed for Paloma Data Bundle.

**How many destination corrections may a Paloma Bill Pay Utilities order receive?** At most 1 over the life of the order.
